_note: Board 642:2832 is the whole 1440 shell with the apply overlay over it; the
overlay is the only thing on it that this surface is about, and it is the only
part of it a probe can hold still — the shell behind it belongs to
shell-default. The overlay portals to the overlay root, so contrastScope is
`body`, not `[data-probe]`.
The board lists SIX steps: the four phases plus 'Testimonials' and 'Footer'.
Those two are NOT adopted, and the code keeps its four. The board queues them
AFTER 'Saving applied state', i.e. after the work they would report has
finished, so its own ordering contradicts the phases beside it; and
`templatesData` exposes a section COUNT (`getSectionCount`), never section
names, so the two labels could only be invented. Everything about how a step
row is DRAWN is the board's and is measured here — 12/18, ink-soft while done
or running, ink-muted while queued, with the state as a word rather than a
glyph and a colour.
NOT joined:
642:3101 (progress fill) — the board's 240px is 60% of the bar, which is
sample data: the fill's width IS the progress. Its height, radius and colour
are the track's and are measured on 642:3100.
I642:3110;9:31 (Cancel's label) — flowbite renders it as the button's own
text node; the button is measured instead.
